crossRefs.note: even as it is written, “Behold, I lay in Zion a stumbling stone and a rock of offense; and no one who believes in him…
Therefore the Lord Yahweh says, “Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious cornerstone…
Kings shall be your foster fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers. They will bow down to you with their faces…
“Blessed is the man who trusts in Yahweh, and whose confidence is in Yahweh.
Because it is contained in Scripture, “Behold, I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen and precious: He who believes…

translations.web: For the Scripture says, “Whoever believes in him will not be disappointed.”
translations.bsb: It is just as the Scripture says: “Anyone who believes in Him will never be put to shame.”
translations.kjv: For the scripture saith, Whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.
translations.asv: For the scripture saith, Whosoever believeth on him shall not be put to shame.
